extracted.intended_audience: Wolfram Language / Mathematica users writing or customizing notebooks (programmers, educators, and advanced users)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for styling and formatting Wolfram Language (Mathematica/Wolfram|One) notebooks: choosing and editing stylesheets, setting notebook and cell properties, preparing notebooks for presentation, printing, accessibility, and adding UI elements such as banners and docked cells.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global Notebook Styling
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall styling and appearance control for an entire notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentation section for controlling global notebook appearance (stylesheets, default cell styles, notebook properties). See related guides on stylesheets and low-level notebook programming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose a Stylesheet for a Notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: Select an existing stylesheet to control the appearance and default formatting of a notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose from built-in or custom stylesheets to set fonts, cell types, spacing, and other appearance defaults for a notebook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit a Style in a Notebook's Stylesheet
rubrics_metrics.description: Modify an existing style definition within a notebook's stylesheet to change how specific cell styles render.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edit style definitions to customize font, color, spacing, and behavior for particular cell styles used in the notebook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set Detailed Properties of a Notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjust fine-grained notebook options and metadata that affect behavior and appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set notebook-level options such as window size, default magnification, save options, and other detailed properties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create and Use a New Style
rubrics_metrics.description: Define a brand-new style and apply it to cells to create custom formatting not provided by built-in styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create custom styles via the stylesheet editor or programmatically; ensure they integrate with notebook workflows and presentation needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set Up a Default Style to Use for Cells
rubrics_metrics.description: Configure which style is used by default when creating new cells in a notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set default cell style to streamline notebook authoring and maintain consistent formatting across content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Styling Specific Content
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply styling rules targeted at particular kinds of content (text, code, outputs, titles, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use appropriate cell styles or direct styling to distinguish content roles (e.g., section headers vs code cells).

rubrics_metrics.name: Add Styling to Text
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply font, weight, color, emphasis, and other inline or paragraph-level styles to notebook text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use menu commands, style boxes, or programmatic functions to style text consistently and semantically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change the Background Color of a Cell
rubrics_metrics.description: Set or change the background color for individual cells or cell styles to highlight or separate content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust background for emphasis or accessibility; ensure sufficient contrast for readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Put a Dingbat on a Cell
rubrics_metrics.description: Add a dingbat (decorative symbol or bullet) to a cell for visual marking or emphasis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use dingbats to denote special cells (notes, warnings); maintain consistency and avoid overuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Put a Frame around a Cell
rubrics_metrics.description: Enclose a cell in a visible frame to set it apart from surrounding content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use framing for examples, important results, or boxed content; balance visual clarity with layout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delete In, Out Cell Labels
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove or hide Input/Output labels (In[ ], Out[ ]) from cells in a notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hide labels for cleaner presentation or when exporting/printing; keep them visible for interactive debugging sessions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insert a Horizontal Line in a Notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: Add a horizontal rule to separate content sections within a notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use horizontal lines to improve readability and logical separation of sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make Bulleted Lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Create and format bulleted (or numbered) lists within text cells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use built-in list formatting to ensure consistent indentation, spacing, and bullet styles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Toolbars & Banners
rubrics_metrics.description: Add toolbars or banners to a notebook to provide persistent controls or information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use banners or docked cells to present controls, titles, or status information; consider window real estate and responsiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add a Banner to a Notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: Place a banner (graphic or textual) at the top of a notebook for branding or identification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Banners can include logos, titles, or navigation; ensure they scale and print appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set Up a Docked Cell
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a docked cell that remains visible at a fixed position (usually top) in the notebook window.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use docked cells for persistent controls, summaries, or navigation; be mindful of screen space on small displays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting Up for Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare a notebook for use as a presentation or slide-style delivery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust styles, magnification, and layout to optimize readability and flow for an audience view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display a Notebook in Full Screen
rubrics_metrics.description: Show the notebook in full-screen mode for presentations or focused work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use full screen to maximize visible content; ensure interactive controls remain accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make a Notebook-Width Image
rubrics_metrics.description: Format an image so that it spans the width of the notebook for visual impact or layout consistency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resize and align images to match notebook width; consider export and printing scaling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify Where a Notebook Should Open on Your Screen
rubrics_metrics.description: Set a notebook's initial window position and size when it is opened.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Control default placement for multi-monitor setups or standardized presentation environments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create a Slide Show Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert or arrange notebook content into a slideshow presentation format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use slide-break cells and presentation stylesheets to structure slide content for delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add a Slide Break to a Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Insert a slide break marker to separate slides within a notebook-based presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place slide breaks logically to preserve narrative flow and pacing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customize the Appearance of a Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Modify presentation-specific styles, themes, and layout options to change the look of slides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust fonts, backgrounds, and transitions consistent with presentation goals and audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modify Styles in a Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Edit or override styles used within a presentation to control headings, body text, and code appearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure modifications improve legibility and maintain consistent hierarchy across slides.

rubrics_metrics.name: Printing & Exporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare notebooks for printing or export to other formats (PDF, HTML, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider page breaks, image scaling, and visibility of interactive elements when exporting or printing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set Page Breaks for Printing
rubrics_metrics.description: Insert or control page breaks to manage pagination when printing a notebook.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place page breaks to avoid splitting important content across pages and to improve printed layout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjust notebook appearance and behavior to improve accessibility for users with visual or other impairments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow accessibility practices such as high-contrast modes, readable fonts, and logical structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display Notebooks White on Black
rubrics_metrics.description: Use an inverted (white-on-black) color scheme for improved readability in certain contexts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply high-contrast color schemes for eye strain reduction or accessibility needs; ensure color choices maintain legibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change the Magnification Settings of a Notebook
rubrics_metrics.description: Adjust the magnification (zoom) level of notebook content for readability or presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set magnification appropriate to screen size and audience; consider separate settings for screen vs print.
